title.en: An Act Declaring June 30 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the City of Imus, Province of Cavite in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary

text.en: June 30 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday and no class day in schools in the City of Imus, Province of Cavite in a commemoration of its founding anniversary.
For work performed on a special working holiday, an employee is entitled to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
